# Data contracts of the national-statistics pack

One section per command of the pack: the shape of its data, how it is stored and checked, and what a person still has to confirm. The rules every contract shares are in [the contracts README](../README.md); the index of every command is [packs/README.md](README.md). The pack's guide, [config/packs/national-statistics/guides/national-statistics.md](../../../config/packs/national-statistics/guides/national-statistics.md), shows the same contracts (generated from the same files, tools/packgen/common/guide_data.py) next to how to use the pack and where each kind's data comes from (*Data retrieval*).

| Command | Kind | Class | Status | Fields | To review |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [NSTAT](#nstat-national-statistic-statistics-series) | `statistics-series` | fundamental | active | 22 | 0 |

## NSTAT: National statistic (`statistics-series`)

One Statistics Canada series by vector: the latest value, the change on the period and the year, the history.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [statistics-series.contract.yaml](../../../config/packs/national-statistics/contracts/statistics-series.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | public data: Statistics Canada, pulled by the national-statistics feed (config/feeds/national-statistics.yaml, tools/feeds/sources/) |
| Grain | One row per national statistic, keyed by SERIES_ID. |
| Key | `SERIES_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^NSTAT-` |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | daily (due: the national-statistics feed's schedule (0 14 * * 1-5 UTC); a pull with nothing new writes nothing and the lake keeps its latest date) |
| Storage | connector `statistics-store` (plugin `delta`), table `<root>/statistics/statistics-series/` |
| Test data | config/packs/national-statistics/samples |
| Worked example | [national-statistics/statistics-series](../samples/national-statistics/statistics-series.md) (a real record, every field explained, for the production query; tools/testdata/sample_docs.py) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SERIES_ID` | id | required |  | NSTAT-V and the Statistics Canada vector number. | `NSTAT-V1` (pattern `^NSTAT-`) |  |
| `NAME` | text | required |  | The series' title in the feed's YAML, as NAME for search. | `Population of Canada` |  |
| `VECTOR` | text | required |  | The Statistics Canada vector id (v and a number): one series of one table. | `v1` |  |
| `TITLE` | text | required |  | The series' title in the feed's YAML. | `Population of Canada` |  |
| `MEMBERS` | text | optional |  | The table's dimension members that make the series, as Statistics Canada names them (Canada;All-items). | `Canada` |  |
| `GEOGRAPHY` | text | optional |  | The series' first member: its geography. | `Canada` |  |
| `TABLE_ID` | id | optional |  | The Statistics Canada table number (18-10-0004-01). | `17-10-0009-01` |  |
| `TABLE_TITLE` | text | optional |  | The table's title in the feed's YAML. | `Population estimates, quarterly` |  |
| `TOPIC` | text | optional |  | The theme the feed's YAML gives the series (Prices, Labour, Output, Population, Housing, Money markets). | `Population` |  |
| `FREQUENCY` | text | optional |  | How often the series is published (Statistics Canada's frequency code, or the feed's YAML when it says). | `quarterly` |  |
| `UNIT` | text | required |  | What the value measures, from the feed's YAML (an index, %, CAD, persons, units). | `persons` |  |
| `SCALE` | text | required |  | The scalar factor the values carry (units, thousands, millions). | `units` |  |
| `LATEST` | amount | required | the record's UNIT | The latest published value, in the unit and scale shown. | `41798407.0` |  |
| `LATEST_PERIOD` | date | required |  | The reference period of the latest value (its first day). | `2026-07-01` |  |
| `PREVIOUS` | amount | optional | the record's UNIT | The value of the period before. | `41718064.0` |  |
| `PREVIOUS_PERIOD` | date | optional |  | The reference period of the previous value. | `2026-04-01` |  |
| `CHANGE` | amount | optional | the record's UNIT | The latest value less the previous one. | `80343.0` |  |
| `CHANGE_PCT` | rate | optional | % | The change on the period in per cent. | `0.1926` |  |
| `YEAR_ON_YEAR_PCT` | rate | optional | % | The change on the same period a year before, in per cent; empty when the history is shorter. | `0.4553` |  |
| `RELEASED` | timestamp | optional |  | When Statistics Canada released the latest value (Eastern time). | `2026-09-23T08:30` |  |
| `HISTORY` | record list | required |  | The value by reference period, oldest first, over the feed's history-periods (PERIOD, VALUE). |  |  |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required |  | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |  |  |

**Nested `HISTORY[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PERIOD` | date | required |  | The reference period (its first day). | `2020-10-01` |  |
| `VALUE` | amount | required | the record's UNIT | The published value for that period. | `38027406.0` |  |

**Nested `PROVENANCE`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | text | required |  | The organisation whose published data the record holds. | `Statistics Canada` |  |
| `DATASET` | text | required |  | The Statistics Canada table and vector the record was built from. | `Statistics Canada table 17-10-0009-01, vector v1` |  |
| `RETRIEVED_AT` | date | required |  | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | `2026-11-06` |  |
| `LICENCE` | text | required |  | The terms under which the source allows reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | `Statistics Canada Open Licence` |  |
| `ATTRIBUTION` | text | required |  | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | `Source: Statistics Canada, <table>. Reproduced and distribu…` |  |
| `URL` | text | required |  | The table's page on the Statistics Canada website. | `https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/t1/tbl1/en/tv.action?pid=17100…` |  |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required |  | True when the source's terms forbid redistribution outside the organisation (Export data refuses the record). | `False` |  |

**Validation**

- required: fields `SERIES_ID`, `NAME`, `VECTOR`, `TITLE`, `UNIT`, `SCALE`, `LATEST`, `LATEST_PERIOD`, `HISTORY`, `PROVENANCE`
- unique: key `SERIES_ID`; per snapshot
- pattern: field SERIES_ID; pattern ^NSTAT-

**Notes**

- Stored in the worldlake lake (config/lakes/worldlake.yaml), table <data>/delta/worldlake/statistics/statistics-series/, one JSONL.gz a business date loaded with mode replace (a rerun of a day is idempotent).
- Delivered as JSON Lines: one document a line, UTF-8, gzipped, with a .ready file naming the lake, pack, kind, connector, business date, mode, key, sha256 and row count (DATA_LAKE_GUIDE.md section 4).
